meta.title: RxGap
meta.subtitle: Pharmacy closure impact explorer
meta.demand: ACS 5-year no-vehicle households (B25044) with margins of error, allocated to residential-classified Overture buildings with block-group fallbacks, then aggregated to H3-9. Demand is clipped to MA cities and towns that intersect the analysis bbox.
meta.network: Overture transportation segments joined on connector_id, pedestrian-accessible classes, covering the analysis bbox. Distances include origin and destination snap legs.
meta.pharmacies: Currently licensed MA Board Retail Pharmacies with usable geocodes in the analysis bbox. Walk-in storefronts are used for routing; excluded licenses still appear with a reason.

pharmacies.source: MA Board of Registration in Pharmacy, currently licensed Retail Pharmacy

boundary_clip.note: Buildings are extracted inside the study union, so residential weight outside the window is unobserved. Area-based ACS share is the proxy.

validation.note: OSRM foot is the comparison router. When it detours more than 2× straight-line (it often refuses a Charles crossing), geodesic is the gate.

cms_check.reason: File is plan-level Part D retail-access adequacy, not a pharmacy address list.
